'''Arsham'''<ref>https://www.instagram.com/p/CZxgs9Nug7B/</ref> is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[A Ripple in Time]]''. He is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who battled [[Ash Ketchum (A Ripple in Time)|Ash]] in a stadium. During the battle, both Trainers' Pokémon moves collided and hit a {{p|Celebi}} observing the battle. As a result of this, Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}} were transported to Future Forest.

The narrator says that both Trainers were using their last Pokémon, which indicates that Arsham has at least one more Pokémon.

==Trivia==
